event_order: world point is constructed evaluator-side without learner access
C1, C2, and reset predictions are computed from state committed after the previous revealed event
all prediction tickets are committed before learner-visible outcome reveal
the identical learner-visible event is revealed to all developmental candidates
proper score is evaluated against each committed prediction
C1 performs exactly one live recurrent update
C2 performs the identical live recurrent update, stores the opaque transition pair, then performs at most one deterministic replay update
resource measurements are adjudicated fail-closed; any candidate resource failure invalidates the whole point
